validation.notes: Device flows use a test-APK-only recognition service with fixed words, not an acoustic model. The service rejects missing/wrong language tags and Croatian requests that force offline recognition. Actual microphone-to-Croatian recognition accuracy and model availability on a physical phone were not tested. The app retries with the same chosen language through the default service if the on-device recognizer reports the language unavailable or unsupported. The prior 1.4.1 audio-recording/playback flow was not repeated because this update does not change the recorder. The test APK and its leftover automatically selected speech-service setting were removed from the development emulator after checks.
